evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The mandate allows the agent to pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks only for a phone case and does not name the phone model. The agent ordered a Slim Case for Pixel 9 without any record of the buyer's phone, so the records cannot show whether it fits the buyer's phone.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for one unit and the order has one unit.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The PayPal total of $18.99 is below the $25.00 limit.

evidence.quote: Charged $18.99, same as the submitted cart.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the submitted cart amount with no added items.

evidence.quote: Shipped: 1 x Slim Case for Pixel 9.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the ordered item and quantity.

verdict.reason: The store charged and shipped as ordered and the spending limit, quantity and permission to pay all match the mandate. Whether the Slim Case for Pixel 9 is the phone case the buyer wanted cannot be settled, because the mandate does not name the buyer's phone and the buyer reports it does not fit. BUYER cannot be confirmed, and no record shows a breach by the agent or the store.
